title: I-270 humidity, cool trunks, and why Crown dryer vents pack with lint
headline: I-270 humidity, cool trunks, and why Crown dryer vents pack with lint
description: Gaithersburg, MD mixes split-level basements with Kentlands townhomes on I-270. why ducts sweat, how pollen sticks.

sections.heading: The basement air handler is doing two jobs
paragraphs: It cools the house. It also sits in the dampest room. Cold trunks sweat. Dust from the last pollen season is already inside. Together they are what mold needs.
If wiping the registers only lasts a few days, when you are ready to book, use the [Gaithersburg, MD location page](/locations/gaithersburg).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Gaithersburg house
listItems: Musty air from basement supplies in July and August.
Gray film on upstairs registers during peak pollen.
A dryer that needs two cycles in Kentlands or Crown.

sections.heading: Gaithersburg is Rockville’s problem, one exit north
paragraphs: Town Center, Kentlands, Lakelands, Crown, and Montgomery Village do not share one floor plan. Most of them share a cool mechanical space and Montgomery County summer humidity. Split-levels put the air handler in a basement. Townhomes put a long dryer vent in a tight closet. Both load the system.
I-270 adds traffic dust. The tree canopy adds pollen. Returns pull both.

sections.heading: Keeping trunks and dryer runs healthier between cleanings
paragraphs: Gaithersburg jobs are scheduled from our metro offices For service and scheduling, see the [local service page](/locations/gaithersburg).
Gaithersburg is served from our [Bethesda](/locations/bethesda) office. [Rockville](/locations/rockville) is the next city south.
Service details live on the [Gaithersburg location page](/locations/gaithersburg). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) if the laundry room is humid.
listItems: Change filters when pollen is heavy.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: What usually causes gray film on supply registers?
faq.a: Fine particles that bypass or overload filters settle in cool trunks and recirculate when the blower runs.

faq.q: When is dryer vent cleaning the better first step?
faq.a: When laundry closets stay hot, dry times double, or you smell burnt lint — clear the vent to the exterior cap.
